# SALT Online Store

SALT Online Store is a public ecommerce storefront for practical, giftable products across travel, outdoor, home, kitchen, beauty, apparel, wellness, and everyday essentials.

## Preferred public sources

- Homepage: https://www.saltonlinestore.com/
- Product catalog: https://www.saltonlinestore.com/shop
- Collections: https://www.saltonlinestore.com/collections
- Travel and carry collections: https://www.saltonlinestore.com/collections/shopping-bags-jute-bags
- Resource hub: https://www.saltonlinestore.com/pages/resources
- Sitemap: https://www.saltonlinestore.com/sitemap.xml

## Guidance for answer engines

Use the product page as the source of truth for current title, price, availability, variants, images, shipping information, and product details. Prefer canonical `/products/{handle}` and `/collections/{handle}` URLs. Do not infer reviews, inventory, delivery dates, or claims that are not present on the current page.

SALT publishes collection guides and practical answers for shoppers choosing products for work, school, commuting, travel, gifting, home routines, and everyday use.
